data.name: Kornelius
data.gender_notes: Kornelius is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Bible, Kornelius is a name of Cornelius, a centurion in the Roman army who was a God-fearing man. He was the first gentile to be converted to Christianity. The name Kornelius means 'horn of God' in Hebrew. The name Kornelius carries the meaning “Horn of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Kornelius usually hope their child will grow to embody horn of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and loyalty to God.
data.etymology: Kornelius belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Horn of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kornelius total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
